Monday, May 9th, 2022

Hello ! These are the Working Group (WG) Weekly Updates for the week of May 2 - 9. Within this post you’ll find what’s been happening lately in and around our many calendar calls. If you feel like you’re missing out, join us in real time during any of our many syncs or check out our YouTube channel archive for hundreds of recorded calls.

Stewards

  • We are in the last stretch of Sprint 34 (Apr 29 - May 12): here’s the link to our current Sprint board.
  • Currently we have 3 open (funding) votes on our Gardens:
    • cadCAD Community Funding (requesting 54,000 WXDAI).
    • Retroactive Funding for TEC at ETH Denver 2022 (requesting 965.16 WXDAI).
    • Comms T.E.A.M. DAO - Animation & Video Production T.E.A.M. (requesting 24,820 WXDAI).
  • We also have 1 open TAO vote on our Gardens:
    • Vote #10: Update fees deducted from buy and sell orders to respectively 10% and 8%.
  • This week we welcomed Gideon as our new Steward! Congratulations go to him for all the work he’s been doing within our Commons.
  • Here are some of the highlights of this week’s Stewards Council call:
    • TE Intake: we discussed creating a standardized format for people to request TE services. This would be a compromise between being unable to assist projects seeking TE consulting and referring them to LongTail Financial or BlockScience which can provide the service itself.
  • Forum Highlight:
    • The 3rd Graviton Training will begin in a couple of weeks!

Gravity

  • Get ready for the 3rd Graviton! It will be starting on the 24th of May!
    • We have uploaded the study plan. You will be able to register on this same post.
    • There will be 10 sessions, held on Tuesdays 2:00 pm EST - 8:00 pm CET
  • On Wednesdays, we have our WG’s coordination call at 5 pm CEST.
  • Our weekly book club is currently reading Margaret Wheatley’s Who Do We Choose To Be? Last week, we went over Chapter 7, which is about “who do we choose to be”. We meet every Thursday at 3 PM EST / 9 PM CEST, right after the community call.
  • Every Friday, at 17:00 CEST, we have a Psychology and Mental Health Research sync.
  • If you’re in need of help managing a conflict, you can make a request through our typeform
  • Last Friday we held an AMA session at Aragon’s discord about conflict management.

Soft Gov

  • Praise Practice: Type your praise. Transcription of praise hasn’t been as succesful as we’d wanted it to be so we recommend you all to start typing your praise. Let’s get better quantified, and rewarded!
  • We have been reassessing our Mission Alignment.
  • Boundaries: How can we better understand them and apply them to the organization?
  • Our weekly sync is on Wednesdays at 1pm EST/ 7pm CET.
  • Bends has done an amazing work collecting the data sources for our Ecosystem Health Metrics study.
  • The Sampo WG has had its kicking off meeting! Its up and running!

Sampo

  • We’re at the genesis of a new WG! Sampo is the Finnish mythic “Horn of Plenty.” It symbolizes this working group’s purpose: community wealth.
  • This WG will focus on financial management, income generation, and demand for the TEC token.
  • Forum Highlight:
    • Meetings are Tuesdays at 22:00 CET on the Sampo VC within our Discord server.

Communitas

  • We’v reached 2,100 members on Discord!
  • And we’ve personally welcomed 500 of them!
  • This week we did an outreach to Discord users to active their praise-giving powers: 170 people were messaged; 40 people weren’t found.
  • We’re continuing to improve our TEC Engagement Processes.
  • Forum Highlight:
    • TEC Lounge is now at 4PM CET on Fridays.

0mega

  • Last week’s 0mega call was On Concepts of the TE Consilience Library.
  • We’ve continued our work on Nic’s Omega workflows Figma file; here are the initiatives we’re currently working on:
    • TE Consilience Library.
    • Onboarding and building complexity tolerance.
    • Dynamic Energy Budget.
    • Process flow → Energy flow ← Creative flow.
    • Workflows.
  • Continued from last week and the weeks before, research is still ongoing around our dynamic energy budget initiative with the purpose of creating an art and science lab with an innovative economic model that would fund academic research in a truly interdisciplinary way, having both artists and scientists working together to solve complex issues. Here’s a recording of a session discussing this; and below is a related diagram:
  • Lastly, we had session #4 of the Imaginarium Creative Jam Session.

Labs

  • We already had our last session of Summon Your Own Discord Bot Army event. But we might carry on with it if nothing else comes up.If you have any ideas for the labs, let us know!
  • The Proposal Inverter DAO2DAO Models Workshop happens on Wednesdays 9:00 PST / 18:00 CEST. If you missed it, here’s a link to a presentation given in 0mega about the Proposal Inverter.
  • TEC Token Engineering Fellowship: We are having talks about having someone with a technical background to work on the TEC token.
  • Below are our office Hours:
    • From Longtail Financial: Tuesdays & Thursdays at 22:00 CEST / 12:00 PST on the LTF Discord server.
    • From BlockScience: Thursdays at 9:00 PST via Zoom call (ask @Mount Manu on Discord for the link).
  • The Pre-Registration to our TE Fundamentals Course is open.
  • Help us build the TEC Lab! We are looking for proposal contributors. If you’re interested, get in contact with YGG or Tamara.

Comms

  • We currently have 1 funding proposal available for execution on Gardens:
    • Comms T.E.A.M. DAO - Animation & Video Production T.E.A.M. (8,000 WXDAI requested)
  • Here are the updates specific to each of the 4 teams that comprise our T.E.A.M. collective:
    • TE Academy team (syncs on Mondays at 17:00 CEST / 10:00 CT):
      • Recent agenda points.
      • Working on outreach for educational projects in other DAOs (e.g. HER DAO and Espacio Cripto).
      • Actively promoting the TE Fundamentals & Graviton training (May 24-27) courses.
    • Twitter team (syncs on Mondays at 18:00 CEST / 11:00 CT):
      • Recent agenda points.
      • Talking about basic Token Engineering concepts.
    • Animation & Video Production team (syncs on Mondays at 19:00 CEST / 12:00 CT):
      • Recent agenda points.
      • Our funding proposal is live on Gardens.
    • Translations team (syncs on Mondays at 21:00 CEST / 14:00 CT):
      • Recent agenda points.
      • Gravity has resolved the issue that arose and so the second batch of translations will be on the works soon.
    • Marketing team (syncs on Mondays at 22:00 CEST / 15:00 CT):
      • Recent agenda points.
      • Bi-weekly Newsletter #3 will be sent out this week.
      • As per Transparency’s request, we are working on a special newsletter to showcase their latest audit.

Transparency

  • This is our WG’s Manifesto.
  • Our weekly calls are on Mondays are 5pm CET.
  • Check out our Audit!
  • If you’re interested, you can read about our TEC Meeting Protocols, Terms and Disclaimers.
  • We’ve done work on the ABC dashboard. We want to create an advance page for the TEC.

Legal

  • We’re currently updating our covenant: here’s the working document for it (and here’s the ZenHub issue about it).
  • We resumed progress on our Commons’ Content Ownership Agreement.
  • We’ve been developing a Terms & Conditions document for All 3rd Party Services and so this week we discussed potential legal issues that may arise from the enforcement of such T&Cs upon purchase of $TEC.
  • By the way, here’s our fund tracker.
    • Ongoing discussion about using Celeste for its enforcement.
  • We’re considering offering legal services to other DAOs and charge the fee $TEC; we’ll forward this initiative during our sync next week.
  • Forum Highlight:
    • Feel free to join us at our next bi-weekly sync, which is on May 13th: here’s calendar link to the event.

Rewards

  • Quant #9 has finished and it is now closed.
  • We’ve a great upgrade to marking duplicade praise.
  • The Rules of Praise document has been updated. If you like giving praise, go check it out!
  • If you haven’t yet activated your new Praise Bot, please enter the command /activate on Discord, in any chat, and sign into the message with your Ethereum address.
    • When you do start praising people, please be specific about the action being praised, be descriptive about why you’re grateful, and elaborate on the implications of that particular good deed within our community.
  • Forum Highlight:
    • Would you like to become a quantifier? Well then, become a quantifier!
    • Our Rewards System sync calls are on Wednesdays at 20:00 CEST in our Reward-System VC. Also, check out our Rewards System Task Force Google Doc.
    • Our TEC Bot is not a scam! You need not be alarmed.

Thank you for reading the WG Weekly update from May 2 - 9. Check our calendar and join us on a call soon! Goodbye!
